items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I remember the names -- but I think this was a little bit before I got out there.

ctx.x: Yeah, there were some Irving Brothers, but ... yeah, they were early, though. Yeah, they were. It seems like one played guitar and another one played bad piano. I think ... I don't know. But yeah, I remember the names -- but I think this was a little bit before I got out there.
And then the next name it lists is Ellighew. Duke Ellighue. Was there such a band in Los Angeles?
